title: Nori-No
prompt:
Create a complete original family-friendly melodic dance-pop song, approximately90seconds. Steady128BPM in4/4. Luminous, uplifting, playful and airy, with flowing melodic verses and a wide memorable chorus. Entirely new composition.

Punchy clear kick drum, dry snare and handclaps, bright shakers, warm bouncing bass, delicate bell/pluck melodies, light marimba and lush but restrained synth chords. Clear musical accents, short rhythmic answers, natural breaths and a few phrase-ending vowels sustained2–4beats. Keep energy and the pulse audible throughout. Warm rounded human mid-register singing with a soft airy edge, clear consonants and gentle chorus harmonies. No spoken words or animal sounds. No ordinary-language lyrics: sing only these invented phonetic syllables. Maintain melodic variety and natural pop phrasing.
